recommendations.issue: Understaffing in the kitchen and front-of-house during peak hours causing severe wait times.
recommendations.action: Adjust scheduling software to increase staffing levels by at least 20% during identified peak rush hours, specifically targeting host, server, and line cook positions.
recommendations.expected_impact: Significant reduction in table turn times, decreased order backlog, and lowered customer wait times.

recommendations.issue: Staff burnout and stress leading to negative customer service attitudes.
recommendations.action: Implement mandatory mid-shift breaks, rotate demanding stations to prevent fatigue, and introduce a weekly staff appreciation incentive program to boost morale.
recommendations.expected_impact: Improved staff demeanor, friendlier guest interactions, and a reduction in service-related complaints.

recommendations.issue: Kitchen rushing orders leading to inconsistent food quality and preparation.
recommendations.action: Conduct refresher training on standardized recipes and plating checklists, and establish a dedicated quality-control checkpoint at the pass before dishes leave the kitchen.
recommendations.expected_impact: Higher consistency in dish presentation and taste, directly addressing food quality dissatisfaction.

recommendations.issue: Menu pricing misalignment with customer perception of value and portion size.
recommendations.action: Audit current menu items for perceived value, adjust portion sizes on underperforming high-priced items, or introduce bundled combo options to increase perceived value.
recommendations.expected_impact: Reduced price-point friction and improved customer sentiment regarding overall value for money.
